AToken.initialize: admin-gated one-time market initialization
AToken.transferTokens: internal shared transfer logic with controller hooks
AToken.transfer: external nonReentrant transfer entry point
AToken.transferFrom: external nonReentrant delegated transfer
AToken.approve: sets transfer allowance
AToken.accrueInterest: applies interest to borrows/reserves and updates borrowIndex
AToken.mintInternal: nonReentrant accrual + mint entry
AToken.mintFresh: mints aTokens after controller check and token transfer-in
AToken.redeemInternal: nonReentrant accrual + redeem entry
AToken.redeemFresh: redeems aTokens and transfers underlying out
AToken.borrowInternal: nonReentrant accrual + borrow entry
AToken.borrowFresh: transfers underlying out and records borrow balances
AToken.repayBorrowFresh: transfers in and reduces borrow balances
AToken.liquidateBorrowInternal: nonReentrant accrual + liquidation entry
AToken.liquidateBorrowFresh: repays borrow and seizes collateral
AToken.seize: external nonReentrant collateral seizure entry
AToken.seizeInternal: moves aToken balances between borrower and liquidator
AToken._setPendingAdmin: admin-gated admin transfer initiation
AToken._acceptAdmin: pendingAdmin accepts admin role
AToken._setController: admin sets controller, checks isController marker
AToken._setReserveFactorFresh: admin sets reserve factor with bound checks
AToken._reduceReservesFresh: admin-gated reserve reduction and transfer out
AToken._addReservesFresh: transfers in and increases totalReserves
